title: How a Godly Man Finishes the Boring Half of Every Job
caption:
The first hour of real work feels like momentum. That's the lie. The actual work starts once the rush is gone.

Whatever you do, work at it with your whole heart, as for the Lord (Colossians 3:23). That includes the invoice, the follow-up, the cleanup nobody claps for.

Finish what the excitement started. That's the whole job.
